name: QAH Git Marketplace
description: Plugins for Quantum Analysis Helper, stored in Git.

plugins.name: Git Plugin Marketplace
plugins.author: Acxel Orozco
plugins.description: Discover, install, update, publish and delete QAH plugins, themes and sandboxed Sentinel addons using a Git repository (GitHub) instead of Firebase. Includes a hard self-update guard.

versions.changelog: Git Plugin Marketplace 1.0.0: public catalog defaults and pull-request contribution workflow.
Automatic pull-request submission: fork, branch, commit and open a PR from the GUI or CLI.
Automatic pull-request submission plus fork sync for older forks.
Git Plugin Marketplace 1.1.2: fixes a QThread cleanup race that could close QAH with a Qt fatal error after publishing a plugin; publish refresh is now deferred until the worker finishes.
Git Plugin Marketplace 1.1.3: adds Install version selection for older releases replacing the current user copy; protects system/wheel plugins from marketplace update, shadowing and Update all.

Git Plugin Marketplace 1.1.4: first-class theme assets (catalog themes section, .qtheme.zip install/update/uninstall, Theme Manager refresh), theme CLI commands, and safe Reload now / Restart later after plugin install. Old catalogs without themes remain compatible.

Git Plugin Marketplace 1.2.0: adds Sentinel addon assets (catalog, Addons filter, .qah install/update/uninstall/publish), addon hash pinning integration, Update all for plugins/themes/addons, and a hard self-update guard that blocks the marketplace from replacing or removing itself while running.

Git Plugin Marketplace 1.2.1: extends the self-protection guard to block deleting the running marketplace's own catalog entry from its UI. Install/update/uninstall self-protection remains in both UI and core.
Git Plugin Marketplace 1.2.2: addon install and publish reject unsupported Sentinel addon API versions and unknown capabilities, matching the catalog validator.

plugins.name: LuaQAH Studio
plugins.author: Acxel Orozco
plugins.description: A professional visual programming studio for Lua inside QAH: typed blocks, connection-aware code generation, undo/redo, syntax-highlighted preview and an interactive Lua terminal.

plugins.name: Plugin Health Guard
plugins.author: Acxel Orozco
plugins.description: Headless startup health check for QAH plugins: manifest integrity, missing entry points, duplicate ids, backup files and stale bytecode, with a JSON report, read-only API and menu actions.

versions.changelog: Initial Plugin Health Guard release: a headless startup plugin health check. No widget; writes a JSON report and provides Run health check / Open report menu actions. Checks manifests, missing entry points, duplicate ids, backup files and stale bytecode.
Plugin Health Guard 1.0.1: adds a read-only health_api for other plugins and reports consumed by Plugin Sentinel's Health tab.
Plugin Health Guard 1.0.2: category changed from development to tools. No functional changes.

plugins.name: Plugin Sentinel
plugins.author: Acxel Orozco
plugins.description: Advanced plugin security audit: risk scoring, capability mapping, native DLL/SO/dylib inspection, trusted baselines, hash watchdog, public watchdog API, installable watchdog builder, sandboxed Sentinel addons with hash pinning, process sandbox, runtime monitor with plugin-execution control, policy gates, Health Guard integration, reports and CI-friendly CLI.

versions.changelog: Initial Plugin Sentinel release: advanced plugin security audit with risk scoring, capability mapping, native PE/ELF/Mach-O inspection, recursive user-plugin discovery, trusted baselines, hash watchdog, process sandbox, live runtime monitor, policy gates, reports and CLI.

Plugin Sentinel 1.1.0: adds public watchdog API for other plugins (watch plugin/library/execution paths, callbacks, poll), a Documentation tab, recursive user-plugin discovery, native inspection, runtime monitor, hash watchdog and process sandbox.

Plugin Sentinel 1.1.1: Runtime Plugin Executions subtab can unload selected user plugins (system/wheel protected), Health tab reads Plugin Health Guard reports, sandbox blocks sensitive credential reads/registry/process creation and adds Windows CPU limits.

Plugin Sentinel 1.1.2: fixes Plugin Executions manager discovery, adds Watchdog Builder that generates installable headless watchdog plugins, and keeps Health Guard integration and sandbox improvements.

Plugin Sentinel 1.2.0: adds the Addons tab and sandboxed addon runtime (.qah source packages, addon.json API v1, hash pinning, capability checks, isolated addon_host with audit hooks, timeouts and memory limits), marketplace addon install integration, and Addon Studio test support via run_addon_folder.

Plugin Sentinel 1.2.1: marketplace addon updates now re-pin automatically from the new verified install record, while a plain local file edit with the same record is still marked modified and blocked. Local .qah imports remain unpinned until trusted.

Plugin Sentinel 1.2.2: addon integrity hashes now exclude marketplace install metadata, so reinstalling the same verified version is not falsely marked modified. Marketplace updates still re-pin from the new install record, and plain local edits are still blocked.

Plugin Sentinel 1.2.3: Plugin Executions now preserves the selected row across the live refresh and only refreshes while that subtab is visible, so Stop selected user plugin is usable. The addon host now accepts high/critical result statuses.

Plugin Sentinel 1.2.4: adds a read-only Dependencies tab for packages injected into QAH's frozen Python (target, package, version, Python/platform, path), with open/copy actions. Documents that injected packages are not plugins and do not appear in Inventory/Plugin Executions.

Plugin Sentinel 1.2.5: groups Watchdog and Watchdog Builder into one Watchdog tab with subtabs, moves Health under Addons as a subtab, removes the psutil warning, prefers a private plugin_sentinel vendor target for optional psutil, and adds Remove package / Remove set actions to the Dependencies tab.

Plugin Sentinel 1.2.6: fixes Inventory layout with compact fixed-width columns and horizontal scrolling; Dependencies now rescans actual dist-info folders so stale manifests cannot hide installed packages; keeps whole-plugin/per-tab scroll areas.

Plugin Sentinel 1.2.7: Runtime sampling is visible-only and user-configurable. Adds 0.5/1/2/5/10 s refresh interval, Pause checkbox, persisted runtime_settings.json, live source/status labels, and stops process polling whenever the Runtime tab is hidden.

Plugin Sentinel 1.2.8: fixes Sentinel addon and sandbox runs inside frozen QAH. Child harnesses now use a real Python interpreter discovered from QAH_SENTINEL_PYTHON/QAH_PYTHON, PATH (python3/python) or the py -3 launcher instead of sys.executable, which launched a second QAH instance and ended as a 60 s timeout. Missing-interpreter now returns a clear error instead of waiting for the timeout; addon read roots include the selected interpreter standard library.

plugins.name: PyDFT Molecule Lab
plugins.author: Acxel Orozco
plugins.description: pydft-based electronic-structure lab for small organic molecules and hormones. Runs bounded single-point Kohn-Sham calculations, reports HOMO/LUMO, gap, chemical descriptors, Mulliken charges and dipole moment, and draws molecular-orbital slices and energy diagrams. Includes E2, EE2, E1, E3, testosterone, progesterone, caffeine and reference molecules.

versions.changelog: PyDFT Molecule Lab 1.0.0: new Analysis-category plugin for pydft single-point electronic structure of small organic molecules and hormones (water, benzene, caffeine, E1, E2, EE2, E3, testosterone, progesterone). Reports energy, HOMO/LUMO, gap, hardness, softness, electronegativity, electrophilicity, Mulliken charges and dipole; plots orbital slices and energy diagrams; exports Markdown/JSON/PNG. Thermal-safe defaults: one thread, low-power grid, iteration cap, stop between SCF steps, no automatic runs. Includes PyQInt HF fallback and PubChem 3D conformers.

PyDFT Molecule Lab 1.0.1: detects and displays the OS logical CPU thread count, populates the CPU thread selector from 1..total, and removes the thermal-safe banner/title. Renames the limits group to CPU and convergence limits. No calculation behavior change; still defaults to one thread and no automatic runs.

plugins.name: PyDFT Workbench
plugins.author: Acxel Orozco
plugins.description: Educational pydft workbench for QAH. Detects pydft from a Wheel Plugin Manager vendor set, runs a CO/STO-3G Kohn-Sham demo and reports energy, HOMO/LUMO, gap, SCF iterations and timing.

versions.changelog: PyDFT Workbench 1.0.0: educational pydft plugin with a Detect dependencies probe, optional vendor-path activation, QC/STO-3G demo for CO/H2O/H2/N2, energy/HOMO/LUMO/gap/SCF timing, and clear instructions when pydft is not injected.
PyDFT Workbench 1.0.1: category changed from science to tools. No functional changes.

plugins.name: QAH SSH
plugins.author: Acxel Orozco
plugins.description: Enhanced Cluster Connector with folder upload/download, background queued transfers and deletes, server-side compressed downloads, command auto-complete, custom icon, temporal files and credential history

versions.changelog: QAH SSH 3.7.0: server-side tar.gz compression for batch downloads, safe local extraction, automatic remote temp cleanup, compressed context-menu action and backup-file exclusion.
QAH SSH 3.8.0: custom SSH terminal icon plus command auto-complete from history, built-in HPC commands and remote compgen suggestions.

QAH SSH 3.8.1: fixes Credential Manager 'Use in Form'. Saved credentials now store the encrypted password token in the credential index, so the form is filled even if shh_info_history.json is missing. Legacy entries fill host/port/user and prompt for the password once.

QAH SSH 3.9.0: adds a sequential transfer queue for uploads, folder uploads, normal downloads and compressed tar.gz downloads, with pause/resume, cancel current, clear finished and per-job status. Existing Upload/Download buttons keep their immediate behaviour.

QAH SSH 3.9.1: moves the Transfer Queue out of the file browser into its own main tab, next to SSH Browser, Text Editor and Temporary Files. Queue behaviour and existing immediate upload/download buttons are unchanged.
QAH SSH 3.9.2: places all Transfer Queue buttons on one row and shortens the control labels to Pause, Cancel and Clear. Queue behaviour is unchanged.

QAH SSH 3.9.3: adds a Queue transfers checkbox. When checked, the main Upload File, Upload Folder and Download buttons add jobs to the Transfer Queue tab; unchecked keeps the original immediate behaviour.

QAH SSH 3.10.0: queued transfers now run in a background worker with their own SFTP channel, so SSH Browser navigation, refresh and other tabs stay responsive during an upload or download. Queue remains sequential; immediate transfers are unchanged.
QAH SSH 3.11.0: Transfer Queue is now control-only: Pause/Resume, Stop current, Stop all, Retry selected and Clear finished. Add jobs from SSH Browser with the Queue transfers checkbox.
QAH SSH 3.11.1: Queue transfers is now checked by default, so uploads and downloads run in the background queue. Compressed downloads always use the background queue even when the checkbox is off.

QAH SSH 3.11.3: keeps Transfer Queue as the second tab and makes Edit in Text Editor / Temporary Files select the Text Editor widget directly, so the correct tab is always focused regardless of tab order.
QAH SSH 3.11.4: moves Queue transfers and Compress on server to a second options row so the terminal is not squeezed, and wraps the whole plugin UI in a scroll area for small screens.

QAH SSH 3.12.0: deletes can now run in the background transfer queue (respecting the Queue transfers checkbox), and removes the redundant Edit in Text Editor toolbar button. Edit remains in the context menu and Ctrl+E.

plugins.name: QAH WS Client
plugins.author: Acxel Orozco
plugins.description: Encrypted WSS remote command console for QAH: connect to a paired QAH WS Server, run commands and receive live stdout/stderr and exit codes.

versions.changelog: QAH WS Client 1.0.0: encrypted WSS connection, one-time invite pairing, password unlock for permanent auto-approve, live stdout/stderr and cancel.
QAH WS Client 1.0.1: default working directory is the server user's home, plus an optional working-dir field.

QAH WS Client 1.2.0: adds relay transport support, a Relay tab showing relay/room/token imported from invites, and an offline Documentation tab covering Tailscale, Cloudflare Tunnel, relay mode, security and troubleshooting. Direct invites and old client settings remain compatible.
QAH WS Client 1.2.1: category changed from development to tools. No functional changes.

plugins.name: QAH WS Server
plugins.author: Acxel Orozco
plugins.description: Encrypted WSS remote command console for QAH: paired clients run commands and receive streamed stdout/stderr, with timed or password-protected permanent auto-approve.

versions.changelog: QAH WS Server 1.0.0: encrypted WSS remote command console with pairing, timed and password-protected permanent auto-approve, destructive-command guard and audit log.
QAH WS Server 1.0.1: fall back to the server user's home when a client sends a missing working directory.

QAH WS Server 1.2.0: adds outbound relay mode (bundled relay_server.py), a Relay tab, and an offline Documentation tab covering Tailscale, Cloudflare Tunnel, relay mode, security and troubleshooting. Direct mode remains the default and old settings keep working.
QAH WS Server 1.2.1: category changed from development to tools. No functional changes.

plugins.name: QAHtop
plugins.author: Acxel Orozco
plugins.description: Lightweight htop-style read-only process and system monitor for QAH. Uses an injected psutil>=5.9.0 when available and falls back to tasklist/ps, with a Detect dependencies probe for Wheel Plugin Manager vendor paths.

versions.changelog: QAHtop 1.0.0: htop-style read-only process and system monitor for QAH. Uses injected psutil when available, falls back to tasklist/ps, includes Detect dependencies to probe Wheel Plugin Manager vendor paths, sortable/filterable process table, and preserves selection across refresh.
QAHtop 1.0.1: declares psutil>=5.9.0 and marks it explicitly optional with dependency_mode=optional and optional_dependencies, while keeping the tasklist/ps fallback and Detect dependencies probe.
QAHtop 1.0.2: fixes QAH sluggishness. Uses fixed table widths and batched updates, preserves selection/scroll, defaults to 3 s refresh, and stops auto-refresh while the tab is hidden.

plugins.name: Runtime Forge
plugins.author: Acxel Orozco
plugins.description: Isolated per-plugin Python runtimes: hash-pinned wheel lock files, per-plugin site-packages, JSON-RPC runtime host, rollback, Sentinel integration, UI and CLI.

versions.changelog: Initial Runtime Forge release: isolated per-plugin Python site-packages, hash-locked wheel installs, JSON-RPC runtime host, rollback, Sentinel integration, UI and CLI. Wheels only; no pip/setup.py/cargo on the user machine.

plugins.name: Secure Share
plugins.author: Acxel Orozco
plugins.description: Encrypted text, file and folder exchange between QAH computers over the LAN or through a private Git relay, with per-device key pairing.

versions.changelog: Secure Share 1.0.0: encrypted text, file and folder exchange over LAN or a private Git relay, with per-device pairing and a PDF user guide.
Secure Share 1.0.1: store peer LAN addresses, TCP reachability probe for the online indicator, direct-address fallback and manual Set address action; updated PDF guide.

plugins.name: Sentinel Addon Studio
plugins.author: Acxel Orozco
plugins.description: Developer workbench for Plugin Sentinel addons: scaffold .qah projects, edit addon.json and main.py, test in Sentinel's isolated addon host, build hash-verifiable packages, install them in Sentinel and publish them to the Git Plugin Marketplace.

versions.changelog: Sentinel Addon Studio 1.0.0: first release. Scaffold .qah addon projects, edit addon.json/main.py/README, choose capabilities, test in Plugin Sentinel's isolated addon host, build hash-verifiable packages, install and pin them in Sentinel, and publish to the Git Plugin Marketplace Addons catalog.

Sentinel Addon Studio 1.0.1: adds a vertical scrollbar to the project form for small screens, makes the action toolbar collapse overflow into its extension menu, and wraps the header so the window can shrink to 640x480.

Sentinel Addon Studio 1.0.2: line-number gutter, Python syntax highlighting, Ln/Col indicator, Validate button, marketplace config preflight/status, package path field, open/copy package actions, and save/build/test/install/publish shortcuts. Publishing still delegates to Git Plugin Marketplace config.

Sentinel Addon Studio 1.0.3: adds a scroll area around the whole workbench and around every right-side tab (main.py, README.md, addon.json, Activity), matching Plugin Sentinel's small-screen scrolling behavior.

plugins.name: SQS Generator
plugins.author: Acxel Orozco
plugins.description: Generate Special Quasirandom Structures (SQS) for binary alloys following Zunger (1990) and van de Walle (2013) methods

plugins.name: Theme Studio
plugins.author: Acxel Orozco
plugins.description: Advanced theme builder for QAH: live preview, token editor, generated QSS, legacy theme.json + CSS export, .qtheme.zip packages and Git Marketplace publishing.

versions.changelog: Initial Theme Studio release: visual token editor, generated QSS, live preview, legacy-compatible theme.json + theme.css export, .qtheme.zip packaging, import and Git Marketplace publishing.

plugins.name: Wheel Plugin Manager
plugins.author: Acxel Orozco
plugins.description: Install, validate, repair, test, build and remove QAH wheel plugins without python.exe. Windows-safe unpacking, malformed-build rejection, and system-pip dependency injection for QAH's frozen Python (e.g. psutil) without rebuilding QAH.

versions.changelog: Initial release: Windows-safe wheel installation without python.exe, wheel validation, fix/repair builds, cross-platform paths.

Wheel Plugin Manager 1.2.0: adds dependency injection for QAH's frozen Python. System pip resolves pre-built wheels for QAH's Python/ABI/platform, verifies tags, unpacks them under QAH/plugins/vendor, and activates them at startup. New inject/deps/deps-verify/deps-remove CLI and GUI panel; psutil works without rebuilding QAH.

Wheel Plugin Manager 1.2.1: prefer the real system Python (py -3.12/PATH/registry) and exclude LibreOffice/OpenOffice/Blender/QGIS/app_packages/site-packages/WindowsApps/Cygwin/MSYS Pythons from dependency injection and verification. Prevents Verify import from reporting success with LibreOffice python-core.

Wheel Plugin Manager 1.2.2: adds --no-deps injection and multiple-requirement inject, plus a GUI No deps checkbox. pydft can reuse QAH's numpy/scipy/numba by injecting pydft pyqint pylebedev --no-deps. Existing Remove package and Remove set deletion paths remain.

themes.name: Studio Aurora
themes.author: Acxel Orozco
themes.description: Aurora-inspired theme with teal accents and a deep navy surface.

versions.changelog: Initial Studio Aurora theme: deep navy surfaces, teal accents and legacy-compatible theme.json + theme.css.

themes.name: Studio Ember
themes.author: Acxel Orozco
themes.description: Warm ember theme: charcoal brown surfaces, orange accent and soft cream text.

versions.changelog: Studio Ember 1.0.0: warm charcoal-brown dark theme with orange accent and cream text.

themes.name: Studio Forest
themes.author: Acxel Orozco
themes.description: Forest theme: deep green surfaces, fresh green accent and calm neutral text.

versions.changelog: Studio Forest 1.0.0: deep green dark theme with fresh green accent and calm neutral text.

themes.name: Studio Ocean
themes.author: Acxel Orozco
themes.description: Deep ocean theme: navy-teal surfaces, cyan accent and cool light text.

versions.changelog: Studio Ocean 1.0.0: deep navy-teal dark theme with cyan accent and cool light text.

themes.name: Studio Paper Light
themes.author: Acxel Orozco
themes.description: Light paper theme: warm white surfaces, blue accent and high-contrast dark text.

versions.changelog: Studio Paper Light 1.0.0: warm white light theme with blue accent and high-contrast dark text.

addons.name: Sentinel Checksum Verify
addons.author: Acxel Orozco
addons.description: Verifies SHA256SUMS, checksums.sha256 and BSD-style SHA256 manifests against the files they reference, reporting matches, mismatches, missing files and unreadable entries.

versions.changelog: Sentinel Checksum Verify 1.0.0: verifies SHA256SUMS/checksums.sha256 manifests with match, mismatch and missing-file reporting.

addons.name: Sentinel File Audit
addons.author: Acxel Orozco
addons.description: Read-only file audit addon for Plugin Sentinel: hashes targets, flags empty files, very large files and executable/script extensions, and writes a markdown report.

versions.changelog: Sentinel File Audit 1.0.0: read-only addon that hashes files, flags empty/large files and executable/script extensions, summarizes folders and writes a markdown report.

addons.name: Sentinel Log Audit
addons.author: Acxel Orozco
addons.description: Read-only audit of QAH and calculation logs: errors, tracebacks, crashes, timeouts, permission failures and credential-looking lines, with masked output.

versions.changelog: Sentinel Log Audit 1.0.0: read-only log/trace audit with masked credential detection.

addons.name: Sentinel Manifest Audit
addons.author: Acxel Orozco
addons.description: Audits QAH plugin and Sentinel addon manifests for missing fields, invalid ids, missing entry files, unsupported addon APIs, risky dependencies, duplicate ids and backup artifacts.

versions.changelog: Sentinel Manifest Audit 1.0.0: validates plugin/addon manifests, entry files, dependencies, duplicate ids and backup artifacts.

addons.name: Sentinel Output Inventory
addons.author: Acxel Orozco
addons.description: Inventories computational output and data files: counts, extensions, total size, empty/truncated/very large files and the largest outputs.

versions.changelog: Sentinel Output Inventory 1.0.0: inventories calculation outputs, sizes, extensions, empty/tiny/large files and largest outputs.

addons.name: Sentinel Secret Scan
addons.author: Acxel Orozco
addons.description: Read-only text scan for private keys, cloud/API tokens, bearer tokens and generic secret assignments. Every reported value is masked.

versions.changelog: Sentinel Secret Scan 1.0.0: masks and reports private keys, cloud/API tokens and generic secret assignments.
